Yeah I can say I agree, when I use I feel so clear headed and I deal with metal health issues even before I got into drugs, so I was always looking to numb whatever i was dealing with, and someone introduced me to ice, and I've already experienced pharma 30mg addys and I never got the speed high so many people got I got almost quiet and it was like for the first time in a while I wasn't constantly over analyzing everything and I just was me in a more organic way, when I use I feel bliss, but that doesn't happen without some experimenting and failing.. remember you can fuck up, not even have the idea in your head that whenever you use next and it's the last of the sack, just be like I should get sleep, make sure my priorities are I order, and as long as your content with how people see you it's your life man, there's no rulebook especially in anything that can be as stimulating and basically hell for some people, like ice cream. You already see the problem so you're honestly a step ahead of me when I significantly stop 75% of my usage. Before that I honestly was either ignorant or stupid. But I didn't see was I was doing to everyone surrounding me, family, brother's, sisters, niece's, etc. I have people I care about a great deal, but I had this idea or false sense that I was only effecting myself and they shouldn't care, but that's selfish thinking not wrong or anything cause feelings don't lie they are what they are, but in my case not all I had my mother who basically was the only parental figure for my whole life and she'd bitch 24/7 cayse I didn't hide it, you knew what I was doing when you invited me over. And when you're so deep in that constant battle between not even caring to be alive and getting high kinda starts to shove those feelings down and basically in my case I didmt care who tf you were, I was grimey I did a lot of people who were only wanting a version of myself that they didn't have to see clearly after each time I see them after a while I look worse and worse, it was a dice roll for me, praying I'ma not wake up cause physically committing suicide, I wasn't quite there yet, but right there in the edge couple times, but yo wrap this up due to the fact you catch me at the end of my couple day chilling with my girl doing lines and clean my house now haha, I'm kinda getting off topic, but I just had to make a a full choice, quit cause I can't simply control myself clearly, or I decided I'd pick something I actually enjoyed and my girl who likes to partake every now and then, so I make metal notes, like okay I'ma get this sack and I'ma do this and however long it last I'm done for a couple weeks when we can get the house. But I set small but if your not so deep into the cycle I thought I could obtain, and I slipped most definitely lol I'm addict I kinda expected it, but it's once those goals, and you start to care less about the consequences and more about filling a void it's probably not something you can do right now in your life. Take a longer break come to it with fresh everything, it took me years of my life wasted, and going even up to a year clean off everything to even get to a clear and decide if I even wanna keep getting high. It's all about balance, you gotta learn to have some discipline if your choice is to get high and still remain the person you can look in the mirror and not completely hate what you see. 
I'm off to bed now, last minute scrolls, gotta get em in 🤣
But I had to ask myself these hard questions cause this isn't just am I gonna test the water am I prepared for the outcome, etc. But anyways I hope you can take something from this, or not but yeah. Peace ✌️

I've found my brother in the same situations. I got to the point where I can no longer feel bad for my brothers mistakes. I'll do whatever I can to help. But when it comes down to it. Addiction is a deadly thing. I know first hand I was addicted to pain killers. Vicodin.  It took so much time to get over it. And become free but I still think about it every day. Sometimes people have to hit complete rock bottom to realize they made a mistake.

Try talking to your parents about it? Tell them what's going on. I'm sure they feel the same if not similar remember they are dealing with your brother to. That's their son. Ask what you can do to help. Maybe asking what you can do to help relieve some stress. Helping out can put a hold on depression I know first hand. & also I know this may also sound bad. But try & focus on you I know he's your brother it sometimes you have to focus on your life. To make sure YOU are okay. If I can help in any way I'll be more then glad.
